messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images, matching its front and back design. Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images. Keep all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then turns his body and head to look over his shoulder, briefly raising his hand to his neck before turning back to face forward.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white, ribbed, long-sleeved turtleneck sweater with a hole in the left shoulder, dark suspenders, and dark, textured trousers.","hair_color":"White","hairstyle":"Short white hair with a distinct undercut, featuring longer, swept-back hair on top and closely shaved sides.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, dark skin, and a short white undercut hairstyle.","scene":"An outdoor paved area, likely a road or parking lot, with a metal guardrail, green trees, and rocky terrain in the background under a bright, sunny sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's light checkered trousers were replaced with dark textured trousers matching the reference. The white ribbed top and dark suspenders remained largely unchanged, and the reference's brown Y-back suspender design was not clearly applied.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's one-piece garment with the reference item, matching its front and back design, while keeping all other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing attributes unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the reference's one-piece garment was intended to include the shirt and suspenders as a single replacement item.
unexpected_changes: The reference's brown Y-back suspender design was not clearly applied; the existing dark suspenders remained.
